items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] They always liked Joyce. Yeah, they did. Everybody liked Joyce.

ctx.x: They sure didn't drink up there. No lick at all. the afternoon and play before the football game like the football game was a Saturday. We were there on a Friday evening. I sure did. I worked there on a Friday. Well they didn't drink up there. They sure didn't. They sure didn't drink up there. No liquor at all. I think I played that one time and they had liquor. One time. One time I think. One time? I think so. One time they would get some liquor in. But otherwise, other times we'd have liquor.

You don't like the maple there? No. I used to carry two glasses at once in case I ran out. They really wore it on. They had a good time. Yeah, it was nice. They always liked Joyce. Yeah, they did. Everybody liked Joyce. I don't see how you worked. I mean, that man. How many jobs would he play? And work?
He was working at the theater. When he'd get off from the theater, he would go to the wax museum, work there. Then go play music all night. And then play a parade?
